hints.title: Row Uniqueness
hints.text: Check that each row contains exactly n distinct numbers from 1 to n.

hints.title: Column Uniqueness
hints.text: Similarly, verify that each column contains exactly n distinct numbers from 1 to n.

hints.title: Early Termination
hints.text: If any row or column contains duplicates or out-of-range elements, return false immediately.

hints.title: Complete Python Solution

complexity.time: O(N) single pass or optimal algorithmic traversal
variables: N: input size or row count
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Searching every number individually yields O(N^3) complexity.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Set/boolean array tracking runs in O(N^2) time and O(N) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Inspect rows and columns in a single pass or modular loop.
